description:
User approved 2026-11-19 ("proceed"), after calling the pin-history comments "the most useless kinds of comments".
Pin tests carry changelog comments: one line per past PR, of the form "(a, b, c) -> (d, e, f): why it moved", sometimes ending "authorized by the user". They tell a reader nothing about what the pin measures now, they duplicate the commit messages (git log -L recovers each), and every PR that moves a shared pin appends a line, so concurrent PRs conflict there (#748 on tests/distill_telemetry_test.rs, 2026-11-19).
On develop 69e5380e4, lines of that shape: src/compiler2/work_start_reason_test.rs 28, tests/distill_telemetry_test.rs 19, src/telemetry/public_trace_test.rs 11, tests/fz2_cli.rs 4, src/compiler2/input_demand_answers_test.rs 4, src/compiler2/reach_test.rs 2. Also sweep for other forms (single-number "636 -> 625", "was N", "+N:") across tests/, src/ and runtime/.
Change: delete every history chain. A pin keeps at most one present-tense sentence saying what it counts, or none when the test name says it. No pin value changes.
Docs: add the rule to the agent docs where pins and goldens are described: a pin's comment says what it counts; why it moved goes in the commit message and PR body, never beside the pin.
Done when: the sweep finds no history comments; gate green; no pin value changed.
title: A pinned number carries no history of its past values
